# Kome.Accumulator vectors: OP A B R, each the 512-byte little-endian hex
# of an integer (byte 0 least significant).
# ADD: R = (A + B) mod 2^4096; SUB: R = (A - B) mod 2^4096.
# Computed with Python integers, independently of the SPARK model:
# random, sparse, carry-chain and wraparound cases, seed 0x6B6F6D65.
# The generator is the "#|" lines below. To regenerate the data lines:
#   sed -n 's/^#| \{0,1\}//p' vectors/accumulator.txt > gen.py
#   python3 gen.py   # prints the ADD/SUB lines that follow this header
#
#| # Kome.Accumulator vectors generator (prints the data lines).
#| # Python integers only, independent of the SPARK model. Wire form: the
#| # 512-byte little-endian encoding of the integer.
#| import random
#| M = 1 << 4096
#| rng = random.Random(0x6B6F6D65)  # "kome"
#| def hx(v): return v.to_bytes(512, "little").hex()
#| def limbs(ls): return sum(x << (64 * i) for i, x in enumerate(ls))
#| ALL = M - 1
#| cases = []
#| for _ in range(24):  # random-looking
#|     cases.append((rng.getrandbits(4096), rng.getrandbits(4096)))
#| for _ in range(8):   # sparse / small
#|     cases.append((rng.getrandbits(64 * rng.randint(1, 63)),
#|                   rng.getrandbits(rng.randint(1, 4096))))
#| cases += [           # carry chains and wraparound
#|     (0, 0), (1, 0), (ALL, 1), (ALL, ALL), (1, ALL),
#|     ((1 << 64) - 1, 1),                    # carry into limb 1
#|     ((1 << 2048) - 1, 1),                  # carry across 32 limbs
#|     (limbs([2**64 - 1] * 63 + [0]), 1),    # carry into the top limb
#|     (1 << 4095, 1 << 4095),                # top bit overflow -> 0
#|     (M // 3, 2 * (M // 3) + 1),            # sums to M -> 0
#|     (limbs([0x8000000000000000] * 64), limbs([0x8000000000000000] * 64)),
#|     (limbs([0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0] * 32), limbs([1, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF] * 32)),
#|     (0, 1),                                # 0 - 1 borrows through all limbs
#|     (1 << 64, 1),                          # borrow from limb 1
#|     (1 << 4000, (1 << 4000) + 1),          # negative difference wraps
#| ]
#| for a, b in cases:
#|     print(f"ADD {hx(a)} {hx(b)} {hx((a + b) % M)}")
#|     print(f"SUB {hx(a)} {hx(b)} {hx((a - b) % M)}")
